q: The Euler-Lagrange equation for a functional J[y] = ∫ₐᵇ F(x,y,y')dx is:
exp: Euler-Lagrange equation: ∂F/∂y − d/dx(∂F/∂y') = 0. This is the necessary condition for y to be an extremum of J[y] with fixed endpoints. Derived by setting the first variation δJ = 0 and using integration by parts. It is a second-order ODE for y(x).
